commentaire: Compatibility zone of this repository for DSH. The compatibility tester (the first step of every install/upgrade) refuses any jump outside it unless --force. The plugin's version is the short git hash (no internal semver). Versions compare segment by segment (0.1.10 is later than 0.1.7). Only min and max are read by the gate; `testees` records what was actually played.
note: 0.2.1-alpha.2 prepared on 2026-10-11, NOT adopted (the machine stays on 0.2.0-rc.2: `latest` is still rc.2 and this is an alpha). Played on an isolated instance (own HOME and DSH_HOME, engine tree installed with the robot's own manifest, profile pins moved to alpha.2): the surface audit finds 0 break among its 11 probes (same as rc.2); the instance boots after TWO edits to the PROFILE, not to this repository: (1) the `tools` entry sets `mode: both`, which alpha.2 no longer accepts (`native` | `ptc` only; `ptc` collapses the native tools into run_code), so DSH stops with « 1 required plugin did not activate » until it is set to `native` (the `both` of 2026-09-17 was a workaround for the glm-5.3-flash route, which encodes untyped object parameters as strings: to re-measure); (2) `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-inspector` is no longer a bundle (its profile part is `dsh-experimental-inspector-profile`) and the native tool `subagent_claude_code` now collides with the `kybernos-workers-claude-code` entry, which no longer activates. 10 live checks replayed against the same checks on rc.2 gave the same result (8 OK; the 2 others fail identically on rc.2). NOT played: language, calls, motion, theme, onboarding, team, skills. 279 of 281 engine packages changed (chat and conversation UI, subagent, session controller, theme), 8 removed (Claude Code and Codex hook bridges, webhook runtime, invariants, schedule bundle), 11 added (persistent terminal, session search and query, session titles, worktree and working-directory tools, schedule tools, translator, inspector). Merge this range only together with the profile edits above and the rest of the live checks. 0.2.0-rc.2 validated on 2026-09-26. Installation: package @deepseek-ai/dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 with the override « dsh-client-ui-settings-account: 0.2.0-rc.1 » (never published); the 15 profile packages moved to 0.2.0-rc.2 by pnpm. The three retouches were re-applied then (queue-move by a three-way merge with zero conflict on six files, 56/56 assertions; workspace-pins, whose anchors all land; goal-affichage, one adapted anchor) and have since moved into the plugins (patches.json). 0.2.0 traps: reopening a session restores the LAST active tab (Chat/Workflows/workflows-v2), so check-goal-affichage forces the Chat tab; a page left open serves the old module graph: reload before any UI proof. History: 0.1.7-rc.2 validated 2026-09-26; 0.1.7-alpha.1 validated 2026-09-22 (the « broken boot » of the day was a profile left on 0.1.6). General traps: the agent-team-web-profile package is stopped (alignment queries the registry); retouches are per version, and « absent » in a retouch check means an anchor to place, not a failure.
